## 1. New Papers Found

### BBN + BSM Physics

| arXiv ID | Title | Relevance to Q2C |
|---|---|---|
| **2610.36062** | Late reheating in the era of precision cosmology | Oct. Finds reheating via decay of a light particle into electrons/neutrinos is compatible with BBN+CMB at temperatures around 0.4 MeV — an order of magnitude below the purely-electromagnetic bound. Key cross-cutting result: standard neutrino radiation can coexist with up to 5x smaller active-neutrino mass density (normal ordering) at unchanged physical masses, and late reheating *suppresses* sterile-neutrino production at mixings within laboratory reach. Directly actionable for our sterile-ν BBN bridge: adds a reheating-temperature knob that competes with the mixing-angle axis our scan tool currently covers alone. |
| **2610.39579** | Cosmological constraints on extra radiation and early dark energy with lepton asymmetry and varying quark masses | Combines three "extra physics at BBN" knobs (ΔN_eff, EDE, lepton asymmetry) with varying quark masses — a more complete nuisance-parameter landscape than our BBN MCP server currently exposes. Worth tracking as a template for which parameters to add next. |
| PRD (Feng, Luo, Kajino et al., published Oct 6) | BBN + Higgs VEV constraints | Follow-up to the Higgs-VEV BBN paper tracked 2026-09-17: a 1.58% uplift in Higgs VEV during BBN reconciles EMPRESS He-4, Lyman-α D/H, and Spite-plateau Li simultaneously, but requires a baryon-to-photon ratio different from CMB — i.e. trades one discrepancy for another. Useful cautionary data point for our bridging work: single-knob fixes to the He-4/D-4 anomaly pair tend to break something else. |
| LBT Y₀ Project (Paper IV, Sep 9; reported widely late Oct) | Y_p = 0.2458 ± 0.0013 from 15 low-metallicity H II regions | **Important tension note**: this LBT measurement (0.5% precision) is *consistent* with standard BBN, in apparent conflict with the EMPRESS-based low-He4 anomaly (Y_p=0.2402±0.0040, tracked 2026-10-24) that is 1σ *below* SBBN. Two independent He-4 determinations now disagree with each other by more than either disagrees with SBBN — before adding a sterile-ν or non-unitary-mixing explanation, the measurement-systematics question needs resolving. Flagging for the next sterile-ν BBN bridge session: check whether our scan tool should report a measurement-selection sensitivity alongside the physics scan. |

### Sterile Neutrinos / Dark Matter

No qualitatively new sterile-ν papers this week beyond the ones already tracked (2610.10585 partially-thermalized eV-sterile-ν, 2610.15060 0νββ/beta-decay). Followed up on last week's finding (via `sterile-nu-bbn-server`'s `check_sterile_nu_sbl_anomaly` tool, exercised informally): the eV-scale parameter space from 2610.10585 (m_s,eff up to 0.35 eV in non-flat w0waCDM) sits outside our current scan tool's default keV-MeV grid — a reminder that the "eV-scale, cosmology-only" sterile-ν regime is a distinct product from the keV-MeV dark-matter-candidate regime our server targets, and the two shouldn't be conflated in future tool docs.

### LZ 248 keV Event — continued model proliferation

| arXiv ID | Title | Relevance |

| **2610.12443** | A scalar-extended U(1)_Lμ−Lτ explanation of the LZ 248 keV excess | Oct 26 (v2). Two complex-scalar extension generating the DM mass splitting via a trilinear coupling after U(1)_Lμ−Lτ breaking. Fourth or fifth distinct gauge-extension model now proposed for the same event (after the dark-Higgs U(1)_X models tracked previously) — the model space is becoming crowded enough that a comparison table (mediator mass, splitting mechanism, distinguishing prediction) would be useful context for `lz-dark-sector-bridge`. |
| **2610.25423** | Exothermic DM with a Dark Higgs: LZ 248 keV + Galactic Center Excess | Oct 18. Dark photon masses near 1 and 26 GeV for ε=10⁻⁴; CMB excludes the lighter branch, heavier branch matches the southern-sky GCE. Another multi-messenger tie-in (GCE) alongside the GW (2610.18234) and solar-neutrino (2610.03692 Higgsino) probes already tracked — strengthens the case flagged last week for a genuinely multi-messenger LZ comparison tool. |
